guidance.summary: Operating margin range of 11% to 12% for the coming year
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: So now that hurdle we have crossed and we hope that now we will be in the range of 11% to 12% operating margin for the coming year.

guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: So whatever capital we are having, we have earlier guided also to grow close to 20% plus kind of growth because we are continuously having a CAGR growth target of 20% plus.

guidance.summary: INR 300 to 350 crores capex in Salarpur in current financial year
guidance.speaker: Rajeev Gupta
guidance.quote: So then in the current financial year, INR 300 crores will be remaining capex of Sanand and another INR 300 crores to INR 350 crores we will use in Salarpur.

guidance.summary: INR 1,500 crores to INR 2,000 crores revenue from Sanand in FY27
guidance.speaker: Anil Gupta
guidance.quote: We expect around INR 1,500 crores to INR 2,000 crores revenue from Sanand in this financial year, which will come in the contribution in this particular -- in FY27.

guidance.summary: Annual capital expenditure of approximately INR 600 crores to INR 700 crores
guidance.quote: Company is expected to incur capital expenditure of approximately INR 600 crores to INR 700 crores annually for next 3 to 4 years.
